entries.description: Read-only navigation guide covering Home and Library after browser sign-in, the separate public listening-room entry, the public artist directory, the sitemap, and crawler policy.
representativeQueries: Where do I sign in to browse Aura Music and manage playlists?
Where can I start or join an Aura Music listening room?

entries.description: Public GET resource containing artist profiles keyed by aliases, track-artist name corrections, and a directory revision. The site's robots.txt disallows crawling /api/; public readability does not change that policy.
representativeQueries: What public profile metadata is available for an artist on Aura Music?
Which canonical artist does an Aura Music artist alias refer to?
What artist-name corrections are recorded for Aura Music tracks?
